units.source_text: 她们之间这种类似的对话，不知道曾经发生过多少次。

en.t: No one knew how many times this kind of conversation had taken place between them.

units.source_text: 但是阿民的决心一点也没有动摇，反而越来越坚定。

en.t: But Amin's resolve did not waver in the slightest; instead, it grew firmer and firmer.

units.source_text: 事实上，阿民无需借助男人的帮助，一个人又是种瓜，又是割麦子，比以前更加卖力气。

en.t: In fact, Amin needed no help from men; she planted melons and reaped wheat all by herself, working even harder than before.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，夏天饲养母牛，雨天也照旧去田里除草。

en.t: Nor was that all: in summer she tended the cow, and even on rainy days she went out to the fields as usual to weed.

units.source_text: 她卖力气的工作，就是对招赘丈夫的某种拒绝。

en.t: Her hard labor was itself a kind of refusal to take in a husband by adoption.

units.source_text: 最后阿住不得不放弃替儿媳妇阿民招赘丈夫的想法。

en.t: In the end, Aju had no choice but to give up the idea of finding an adopted husband for her daughter-in-law Amin.

units.source_text: 不过，放弃这个想法，对阿住来说，不一定是一件不愉快的事儿。

en.t: Still, giving up that idea was not necessarily an unpleasant thing for Aju.
